title: The Real Story Behind Timber + Love: What We’ve Built and Why It Matters

blocks.text: Every successful venture has a compelling origin story, and Timber + Love is no exception. For Luke Caldwell and his team, the narrative of this prominent Boise design-build firm is deeply intertwined with personal mission, strategic growth, and an unwavering dedication to craft. What began as a hands-on real estate and renovation practice has blossomed into a company synonymous with intentional design, superior construction, and a profound impact on the Treasure Valley.

In the early days, before the HGTV cameras, Luke was deep in the Treasure Valley real estate market — buying, renovating, and learning the craft from the ground up. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for transforming spaces, and soon, renovation work evolved into a desire for more enduring, thoughtful design and construction. This period forged not just a business model, but a philosophy: every project had to be handled with care, attention, and a deep understanding of its purpose.

Timber + Love was born from this commitment. Recognizing the disconnect often inherent in traditional construction projects, where designers and builders operate in separate silos, Luke envisioned a seamless, integrated approach. Timber + Love manages the entire design-build process under one roof. This holistic model eliminates communication gaps, streamlines timelines, and ensures unparalleled quality control from conceptualization to the final nail. It means one cohesive vision, one accountable team, and one exceptional outcome.

The team at Timber + Love is composed of highly skilled artisans, innovative designers, and meticulous project managers who share Luke’s vision. They are driven by a collective pursuit of excellence, understanding that true craftsmanship lies in the details—the choice of materials, the precision of execution, and the longevity of the finished product. A strong preference for local hiring further reinforces their community ties, ensuring that the talent and resources of Boise are continually invested in.

When “Boise Boys” hit the national stage, it brought Timber + Love’s work to a wider audience, showcasing designs that balance bold aesthetics with livable functionality. Viewers responded not just to the beautiful transformations but to the authenticity and passion evident in every project. The show validated their integrated approach, proving that a Boise-based firm could set national benchmarks for design and construction quality.

Today, Timber + Love continues to build on this legacy. Whether it’s a bespoke custom home, a thoughtful renovation, or a commercial design, each undertaking reflects their core values. They build relationships as much as structures, striving to exceed client expectations and create spaces that resonate with their owners’ lives and aspirations. It’s more than just construction; it’s about crafting legacies, one intentional, beautifully built project at a time.
